goal: Reduce CompilationUnit's output coupling by extracting token/position range recalculation (JavaToken, Position, TokenRange, Range and EOF usage) into a dedicated helper, removing those direct type dependencies from CompilationUnit.

ops.details: Move the recalculatePositions() method into a new helper class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator. The new class will perform the iteration over JavaToken, use EOF/range/Position and set ranges on tokens. In CompilationUnit replace recalculatePositions() with a delegating call (e.g. new CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator(this).recalculatePositions()). This removes direct references to JavaToken, Position, TokenRange (and the static imports for EOF and range) from CompilationUnit.

outputs: javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnit.java (remove imports/static imports used only by recalculatePositions)
javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator.java (add imports/static imports for JavaToken, Position, Range, EOF)
ops.details: Remove JavaToken/Position/Range related imports (and static imports EOF, range) from CompilationUnit and add them to the new helper's imports. The new helper will depend on TokenRange access via the CompilationUnit API (it will call compilationUnit.getTokenRange()).

outputs: CompilationUnit delegating method and any internal direct usages updated to call the helper
ops.details: Ensure the public API remains the same (CompilationUnit.recalculatePositions() exists but delegates to the new helper). No external API signature change occurs.
